value.name: urge investigation of codicil
value.description: Asha urges Daniel to investigate the rumored codicil before making any irreversible decisions.
evidence: we owe it to your family's legacy to investigate before making any irreversible decisions.

value.name: Daniel rejects rumor chasing
value.description: Daniel says he cannot believe they are entertaining the idea and wants to end the matter quickly.
evidence: I can't believe we're even entertaining this idea; chasing down rumors won't pay my bills or clear my name—let's just get this over with.

value.name: Asha proposes meeting witness
value.description: Asha argues that they should meet with the witness to learn more about the codicil and avoid future complications.
evidence: let’s just meet with the witness and see what they have to say.
ignoring the possibility of the codicil could lead to complications that may cost you more in the long run

value.name: Daniel fears plan disruption
value.description: Daniel worries that if the codicil is real, it will throw their plans into chaos and derail the sale.
evidence: If it turns out this codicil is real, then what? We're just going to throw our plans into chaos?
we need to stick to the plan and sell.

value.name: Asha warns of financial and legacy risks
value.description: Asha warns Daniel that failing to address the issue could harm both his finances and his mother's wishes.
evidence: if we don't address this now, we risk not only your financial stability but also the integrity of your mother's wishes

value.name: Daniel agrees to brief meeting
value.description: Daniel reluctantly agrees to a brief meeting with the witness but insists it must not drag on.
evidence: I suppose a brief meeting with the witness couldn't hurt, but let's be clear—I'm not letting this drag on longer than necessary

value.name: Asha frames meeting as clarifying legacy
value.description: Asha thanks Daniel for considering the meeting and says clarity now can prevent chaos later while honoring his mother's legacy.
evidence: I appreciate your willingness to consider it, Daniel; just remember, clarity now can prevent chaos later, and your mother's legacy deserves that respect.

value.name: Asha urges open-minded meeting
value.description: Asha asks to approach the witness meeting with an open mind because it may reveal helpful insights about the mother's intentions.
evidence: Let’s approach this meeting with an open mind; it may reveal insights that could honor her intentions and guide us through this process more smoothly.

value.name: Daniel reveals self-interest
value.description: Daniel admits that the issue is not only about honoring his mother's intentions but also about securing his own future.
evidence: this isn't just about honoring her intentions; it's about securing my future too
